cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Anything but That Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every attempt to discuss the one detail that could expose your real motive or involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I'll return your spare key after dinner. Have you booked somewhere?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I never gave you a spare key. Where did you get it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Let's get a table before everywhere fills up.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked. Did my sister give you that key?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For two or three? We can't leave your sister without dinner.

mechanism: A turns its pupil questions about unauthorized key access into corrections of dinner planning, using the named sister to divert into guest numbers.
confusable: Not innocent topic change: B repeats the source question and A repeatedly answers a safer planning detail through old hosting lessons.
comparison: Avoiding source of key versus avoiding identity in photograph.
